match.title: Kenya vs South Africa AFCON 2027 Qualifiers 3D Soccer Pitch Graphics Analysis
match.resultNote: Three goals are shown in the clip: South Africa scored at 67:09 and 85:42 on the broadcast clock, Kenya at 88:00. The broadcast scoreboard reads Kenya 1–2 South Africa.
match.window: the three goals, all in the second half

footage.kind: Broadcast highlights from one main camera, 640 × 360, 2 min 36 s, with the match clock and score on screen
footage.rights: Used with the permission of the rights holder.
footage.method: Events placed by eye from the pitch markings to within about 5 m; at this resolution shirt numbers on the ball are not legible, so no player is numbered.

coordinates: x from the left goal line (0-105), y from the near (camera-side) touchline (0-68). t is the broadcast match clock in seconds; videoOffset adds the seconds that turn it into time in the clip. All three passages are in the second half: Kenya attack toward x = 0 and South Africa toward x = 105.

sequences.title: South Africa 0–1
notes: South Africa carried the ball about 47 m down the near side in two runs, from just inside Kenya's half to the corner of the area, in about 7 seconds.
A Kenya defender ran alongside the carrier the whole way and never got goal-side, so the ball could be played across the six-yard area.
The finish came from about 4 m in a crowded six-yard area. The footage does not show the last touch clearly, so no scorer is named.

sequences.title: South Africa 0–2
notes: South Africa moved the ball through a crowd of Kenya players at the edge of the area: two passes of about 9 m and 10 m in under 2 seconds.
The second pass put a runner inside the area about 11 m from goal, beyond the Kenya players who had stepped toward the ball.
The goal came about 4 seconds after the first pass. The finish is too small to read at this resolution, so no scorer is named.

sequences.title: Kenya 1–2
notes: Kenya's goal came from a free kick on the far side, about 40 m from goal, delivered about 33 m into the area.
More than ten players were inside the area when it was struck, and the ball was finished from about 6 m two seconds after the delivery.
Several South African players raised their arms after the finish. The footage does not show why or who made the last touch, so no scorer is named.

events.note: Free kick from the far side.
